牛肚子里的消化器整天都在工作。

爷爷今天怎么显得这么庄重呀？

diligence: Diligence helps you do well at school.

这个房间怎么这么又旧又暗呀？

diplomacy: Diplomacy is using nice words, not noise.
外交就是好好说话，而不是吵吵闹闹。

外交能帮大家成为朋友吗？

这场大雨把野餐全毁了。

遇到灾难我们能做些什么呢？

你能从歌里听出我的声音吗？

discipline: Does your sister have good discipline?

discouraged: He was discouraged in the cold rain.

discovery: My discovery of a starfish made my day!

discriminate: Good friends never discriminate at play.
好朋友玩耍时从不歧视别人。

discrimination: Discrimination is bad and makes people cry.
